How a floor gets done

  1. 1

    Walkthrough & estimate

    Your space is measured and the concrete is checked, so the estimate is built on the floor you actually have.

  2. 2

    Surface preparation

    Grinding and shot-blasting open the concrete so the system bonds mechanically — the step that decides how long a floor lasts.

  3. 3

    Repair & system install

    Cracks and joints are filled, then the chosen system goes down in coats — base, body, and a topcoat matched to your traffic.

  4. 4

    Cure & back to work

    Once cured, line striping and markings go on and the floor goes back into service.
